hypothesis: Starting the existing exact-delta min-conflicts kernel from structurally diverse members of the verified 328-graph order-42 catalog can reach order-43 basins not represented by the single Exoo seed.

selected_lines.selection_rule: For each observed edge count 424 through 430, take the first, median, and last catalog occurrence; also take the unique 423-edge graph. Store the resulting labels in increasing order.

execution_rule: The runner must validate this schema, every pinned path and SHA-256, the selected-lines hash/count, and every configuration field before creating outputs.
Run exactly the 22 selected labels with derived seed seed_base + catalog_line.
Refuse to overwrite any existing output.
Stop ordinary scheduling immediately if E=0 appears; preserve the graph and require both independent verifiers.
Treat every nonzero objective only as a reproducible computational observation.

outcome_policy.DUAL_VERIFIED_SAT_CONSTRUCTION: Preserve all representations and begin adversarial verification for a lower-bound claim.
outcome_policy.COMPLETE_NO_CONSTRUCTION: Use objective distribution and basin diversity to decide whether a full 328-line sweep has sufficient information value.
outcome_policy.TIMEOUT_OR_ERROR: Mark the pilot incomplete and make no aggregate search claim.
outcome_policy.scope_warning: Failure to find E=0 is not evidence that an order-43 Ramsey graph does not exist.
